reason: $99 is about two weeks of my family's income, and we already pay for IELTS prep. For Germany, Poland or Turkey I can check deadlines and costs on the university sites myself, so I will use the free part and maybe the free practice uni-assist application, and stop there.
objection: We don't know if the data is correct, and a refund after a missed deadline doesn't give my child the year back. Most of the package (Common App, UCAS, unlimited essays) is for families going to the US or UK, not for cheap Europe and Asia like us.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper plan around $25-30 only for Germany/Poland/Korea/Turkey, after the free version shows me correct deadlines and costs for universities I already checked myself.
